items.title: State of the blog, mid-2026
items.summary: As I navigate my career change after Ai2 , I wanted to share my views of how this blog relates to my missions and broader work. In my farewell post, I summarized my three goals right now as: Provide clarity in the evolution of frontier models. Create a vibrant and diverse open (model) ecosystem.
